text: Welcome, friend!
zh: 欢迎啊，朋友！

text:
You look like you can handle yourself.
Fancy a fight in our #text.highlight#arena#text.default#?
zh:
看你身手应该不赖。
想不想在我们的#text.highlight#竞技场#text.default#里打上一场？

text: Knew I'd see ya again!
zh: 我就知道还会见到你！

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: May I fight in the arena?
zh: 我可以在竞技场里比试吗？

text: I want to fight.
zh: 我想打一场。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: I manage the fights here in the slums. It's dirty but can pay handsomely.
zh: 贫民窟这儿的打斗都归我管。活儿是脏了点，但赏钱可不少。

text: If you think you got what it takes to take on one of my lads then be sure to let me know.
zh: 要是你觉得自己有本事跟我手下的小子们过过招，尽管来找我。

text:
'Course!
As long as you can hold a weapon, that is.
zh:
当然可以！
只要你还拿得动武器就行。

text: We have a variety of fighters 'round here, all with different skill levels.
zh: 我们这儿的斗士各式各样，水平也参差不齐。

text: Familiar with the rules?
zh: 规矩都清楚吗？

text: No. Tell me the rules.
zh: 不清楚。跟我说说规矩。

text: Yes.
zh: 清楚。

text: Well... it's pretty simple.
zh: 嗯……其实很简单。

text: First, you tell me who you want to fight and pay the stake.
zh: 首先，你告诉我想跟谁打，然后付下注钱。

text: Then, move into the arena, wait for your opponent and have at 'em.
zh: 接着走进竞技场，等你的对手上场，然后放开了打。

text: If ya leave the arena before either of you drop, the fight's over and ya lose.
zh: 要是双方都还没倒下你就离开竞技场，比试就算结束，判你输。

text: The most important rule is: "We all fight for our lives."
zh: 最重要的一条规矩是："我们都在为活命而战。"

text: You may leave the arena in shame, die a honorable death, or come out victorious.
zh: 你可以灰溜溜地离开竞技场，可以光荣地战死，也可以凯旋而归。

text: Catch all that?
zh: 都记住了？

text: Yes.
zh: 记住了。

text: Please repeat the rules.
zh: 请再说一遍规矩。

text: Alright then!
zh: 那就好！

text: Come back anytime if you want to fight!
zh: 想打的时候随时回来！

text: Alright, friend! Let's see...
zh: 好嘞，朋友！我看看……

text: Who do you want to fight?
zh: 你想跟谁打？

text: An easy opponent. (20 gold)
zh: 来个好对付的对手。（20金币）

text: Give me a fighter. (100 gold)
zh: 给我来个真正的斗士。（100金币）

text: I want a challenge. (200 gold)
zh: 我想要点挑战。（200金币）

text: Nevermind.
zh: 算了。

text:
Very well.
This one's pretty green, but he's got a couple fights under his belt.
zh:
很好。
这家伙还嫩得很，不过好歹也打过几场。

text: Now enter the arena and give us a good show!
zh: 现在进竞技场吧，给我们来场好戏！

text: Well done, friend!
zh: 干得漂亮，朋友！

text:
Left the arena?
Well... you aren't the first but I expected better.
zh:
离场了？
唉……你不是第一个，但我本来觉得你能行的。

text: Don't make a habit of it, yeah?
zh: 别养成习惯，行吗？

text: He was a newbie, but 30 gold should be good.
zh: 他是个新手，不过30金币也不算亏了。

text: Your opponent certainly weren't no pushover. Here, 150 gold for your trouble.
zh: 你那对手可绝不是软柿子。给，150金币，辛苦费。

text: Got cold feet, eh?
zh: 临阵怯场了，嗯？

text: Would be careful 'round this one. He isn't anything special but he'll put you through your paces.
zh: 对付这家伙得当心点。他没什么特别的本事，但绝对够你受的。

text: One of our finest. Can't say I'm feeling too confident for you in this case.
zh: 我们这儿数一数二的好手。这回我可不敢说看好你。

text:
Mighty impressive work in there!
Won yourself 300 gold. Be sure to spend it with pride, friend.
zh:
场上那表现太带劲了！
你赢了300金币。可要花得体面点，朋友。

text:
That's the last straw, friend!
I'm revoking your right to fight in the arena. Go waste someone elses time.
zh:
我忍你到头了，朋友！
你在竞技场比试的资格被取消了。浪费别人的时间去吧。
